title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
dek: The listing titles use both words. Here is what to check on the page before you decide.
status: Published as a working draft. No named editor (FLG-R12).

body.text: The three air fryers we checked use different shapes, and their listing titles say so. One is titled as a dual basket air fryer oven ({{P-01}}). Another is titled as a French door multi-function air fryer toaster oven ({{P-02}}). A third is titled as an 8 Qt air fryer with a 4-in-1 function set ({{P-03}}).

items: How many cooking areas do you need: one basket, or two?
Do you want the appliance to bake, roast or toast as well as air-fry?
Will it fit where you want it? Check the dimensions in the listing's product information.
Do you need to see the food while it cooks? Check whether the listing mentions a window or door.

body.text: We did not test these appliances, and we did not confirm how any of them cook. The listing titles are the only product text this guide is based on.
Open each listing, read its product information table, and compare the same measurements side by side.
